verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry is documented to automatically reduce telemetry costs (up to 80%) by identifying and aggregating low-value data, which helps with spend control, and alerting/SLO features could be repurposed to flag spikes. However, there is no evidence of dashboards or reports that attribute observability spend specifically to teams or services, nor of built-in usage-spike alerting tied to billing thresholds. Missing for 10: cost attribution by team/service, usage-based billing dashboards, spike/anomaly alerts on spend itself.
